title: Rendering subclass projections and typed preset output

sources.role: RENDERENVIRONMENT group1 is image filename; three290 flags, three280 channels and four40 values
RapidRT base/derived subclass split; base preview, description, display index and fifth290 predefined
documented legacy MentalRay base has texture-quality90, three290 flags, two base strings; MI statistics filename belongs to derived subclass
VisualStyle complete property schema exceeds current DXF desc/type projection and remains a distinct qualification requirement

scope: DXF named RenderSettings projections; no native byte-layout change
implementation: Original base-subclass DXF named projections preserve all positional vectors/raw tags and distinguish documented legacy MentalRay quality/flags/preview from derived MI data.
Environment filename aliases use the existing shared retained-byte lease; no installed data member or interface virtual added; native byte-layout and native finalization unchanged.
Complete RapidRT and legacy/modern-base MentalRay DXF vector profiles emit canonical base/derived fields. Profile/record-name/projection/opaque/finite/width guards refuse before record publication.
Unknown/foreign raw data and incomplete profiles do not become semantic source evidence or qualified typed preset output. Existing raw same-version converter replay remains separate.

baseline.note: The standalone executable linked the pre-change library before the owning rebuild; its exact library hash was not captured. The retained test-source digest and red log are diagnostic evidence, not current-source qualification.

diagnosticFailuresAndLimits: Standalone writer harness initially dereferenced unset adapter writer state; corrected harness uses no-op ordinary callbacks. This was a harness failure, not library crash evidence.
Harness then exposed an unresolved authored XDATA APPID; stripped metadata for the independent preset-body control. Existing owner/metadata lanes remain separate.
Initial malformed-width control used2147483648, which fits the accepted unsigned32 carrier; corrected control exceeds32 bits.
Projection-stage builds/packaging are retained but superseded by the final source freeze after the writer fix.

typedWriterRedProbe.result: Both ASCII and binary writes/reads succeeded but name was empty and class/display were0; retained strings still3.
typedWriterRedProbe.fixedBy: canonical base/derived preset output with exact physical-body/readback and refusal/retry controls

limits: full RenderSettings or VisualStyle semantic support
Original source/reference facts are not full consumer, rendering, geometry, edited/output or native qualification.
Nonzero clipping-boundary and shade/rendering/background/sun targets remain unavailable until their own semantic producer/geometry/ownership evidence is complete.
Layer VP override carriers335/343/344/91 are not modeled and cannot qualify this profile. Existing legacy46/76/148/451/452 parser aliases also remain unqualified pending producer/version evidence.
No complete recursive/coupled/whole-document ownership, native default/name/collation, full B2b/B3/C, controlled memory/performance or formal ABI/native application qualification.
Modern MentalRay shared-base shapes are authored compatibility controls, not independent producer/vendor semantic evidence.
Typed preset output qualifies selected DXF bodies only; version/classes/document ownership, recursive closure, edited raw-converter replay, native rendering and engine semantics remain open.
Generic source-less finalize() remains the separate legacy/native convenience path; it cannot supply original subclass evidence.
next: Actual original VisualStyle/RenderSettings publication/model/raw/state/profile/origin pairs using shared bounded replay and independent full-property inventories.
Original rooted rendering references then background/live-section/sun providers.
Remaining VIEWPORT/other producers, recursive ownership, live/emitted/TABLE output and full B2b/B3/C.
Release/consumer/native/external qualifications; preserve fast owning and risk-based affected validation with self-updating commits.
